title: Console data module generation
responsibility: Turns recognized history-index files into server module text and estimates the resulting bundled size.

inputs.name: consoleDataModules.files
inputs.description: An array of history-index entries, each with a relative path and raw Uint8Array bytes. The function emits only index.json, activity.json, lower-case 40-hex JSON files under revisions/ or sides/, and media/ paths with a 64-hex digest plus lower-case alphanumeric extension; other paths are ignored.

inputs.name: bundledSize.modules
inputs.description: An array of host-file records with path and string contents; each contents string is measured and gzipped independently. An empty array produces null, while a nonempty array includes every supplied module in the totals.

examples.contents:
// Generated by `harness console install` from a history index. Do not edit.
export default "{\"version\":1}";

outputs.name: consoleDataModules
outputs.description: One host-file record is returned for each recognized data or media entry, with generated paths under the console server data directory. JSON entries embed UTF-8 decoded bytes as a JSON string default export; media entries embed base64 bytes and export the extension MIME type, falling back to application/octet-stream for unmapped extensions.

examples.contents:
// Generated by `harness console install` from a history index. Do not edit.
export default "{\"version\":1}";

outputs.name: bundledSize
outputs.description: Returns null when no modules are supplied. Otherwise it reports module count, the sum of JavaScript contents.length values, and the sum of gzipSync(contents).length for each module.
